monitor SQL definitions, canonical hash and half-open UTC slots match the TypeScript contract
monitor publication retains exact receipts across revisions and refuses stale or changed commands atomically
monitor publication requires the authenticated self executor, exact current rule and current routing recipients
a protected tick creates one scheduled run with immutable human requester and site audit provenance
a missed grace window is recorded as unknown without running historical source work
maintenance consumes the actual due slot without source work and silence only suppresses delivery
pause and resume retain paused slots and retirement cannot silently reactivate a monitor
overlap and per-source scheduled capacity are finite skipped occurrences rather than duplicate runs
expired authorization records a blocked occurrence without changing the executor identity
canonical FAIL projection opens one owned SLA issue and replay never duplicates its journals
repeated same-scope FAIL reuses the issue and acknowledgement assignment preserve opening SLA
linked later PASS permits explicit resolution and reopening preserves the immutable resolution evidence
manual PASS runs never become linked recovery and fabricated evidence cannot resolve an issue
a late PASS with a newer pending occurrence never emits recovery available
a newer NO_DATA or failed occurrence keeps recovery unavailable and projects unknown honestly
changed current rule or source configuration cannot make a retained PASS eligible for resolution
read-only consumers see authorized monitoring but cannot publish or change issue state
resume reauthorizes every retained recipient and exact command replay respects current visibility
revoking the issue owner does not discard a completed observation or falsely deliver a notification
scheduled completeness rechecks rule owner at claim and finish without changing legacy manual runs
executor and target authorization are rechecked between admission and execution
recovery requests require the immutable executor but do not require quality write permission
notification ownership, exact read replay and current issue visibility are enforced independently
selected historical definitions and issues remain visible when a newer reference-restricted head is hidden
superseded issue visibility includes the exact replacement definition and closes after endpoint permission loss
signed monitoring cursors bind tenant actor limit and filters while every page rechecks authority
forced tenant RLS direct DML and private helper grants prevent bypassing protected monitoring commands
observed rule-owner lock blocking rechecks current authority before stale pin diagnostics without source prelocks
scheduled reference checks retain exact reviewed binding and comparison scope without exposing codes in monitoring DTOs
scheduled uniqueness binds its byte budgets and projects an independently aggregated duplicate-group result
scheduled range binds exact integer bounds to a real bigint target before aggregate projection

monitoring head seal rejects forged last-conclusive evidence after a valid committed projection
monitoring segment seal refuses silently skipping unrecorded due slots
